task:
FIX FOUR CODEX REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #817 (purge P1, migration 016), review round 2. Update only the existing branch codex/run-38689108057-1; its head must be 733b4988a8219db4679ece3e34ac790f5b4a8acd (full SHA from git rev-parse of origin/codex/run-38689108057-1; if it differs, stop and report the SHA you found). Read CLAUDE.md and docs/development/v3-governed-derived-purge-design.md sections 4.1 and 4.2 (the recovery rules for open BATCH_STARTED / REWRITE_STARTED / SERVICES_QUIESCED / AUTOVACUUM_DISABLED / WRITER_FENCE_ENABLED records) first. All four findings are confirmed; fix each in sql/v3/migrations/016_v3_governed_derived_purge.sql with a PG18 test in tests/test_v3_governed_derived_purge.py that fails on the current head.

K1 (P1, ~line 41, role adoption): when v3_derived_purge_executor already exists, also validate the INCOMING membership graph: the only role allowed to be a member of the executor is the creating role (current_user), with set_option true, inherit_option false and admin_option false; any other member (any pg_auth_members row with roleid = executor and member <> creator), or admin_option on the creator's membership, refuses with a clear message. For a superuser creator (no membership needed), require that the executor has NO members at all except possibly the creator with the same SET-only/non-admin options. Tests: an existing executor with an extra member refuses; an existing executor whose creator membership has ADMIN OPTION refuses; the clean adoption still works.

K2 (P1, ~line 945, rewrite cancel): cancel_purge_rewrite / cancel_purge_backend currently authenticate the recorded rewrite backend only through pg_stat_progress_cluster, which has no row while VACUUM FULL is still WAITING for its ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, so controller loss can leave an unobserved rewrite to proceed later. Also accept the backend when, for the exact PID and backend_start recorded by the open REWRITE_STARTED, pg_stat_activity shows a VACUUM command in this database (query text bounded/normalised; do not trust arbitrary text alone) AND pg_locks shows an ungranted (granted = false) lock request by that PID on exactly the recorded relation OID. Keep refusing every other PID/backend. Test: hold a conflicting lock on the relation from another session, start the rewrite so it waits, and prove cancel succeeds against the waiting backend and the open REWRITE_STARTED resolves as REWRITE_ROLLED_BACK (relfilenode unchanged).

K3 (P1, ~line 845, idempotent rewrite): the REWRITE_STARTED path checks only for an unresolved rewrite and the logical-empty receipt, so a retried dispatch after a successful REWRITE_VERIFIED for the same purge and relation can start another VACUUM FULL. Refuse to open REWRITE_STARTED (and refuse to disable autovacuum for a new rewrite) when a REWRITE_VERIFIED already exists for that purge_id and relation; return/emit an explicit already-verified outcome the operator action can treat as the idempotent no-op the design requires. Test: after REWRITE_VERIFIED, a second start is refused/no-op and no new REWRITE_STARTED or AUTOVACUUM_DISABLED event is appended.

K4 (P2, ~line 894, services quiesce): a retried dispatch can append a second SERVICES_QUIESCED with a different (smaller) container set while the first is unresolved, and the later SERVICES_RESTORED then closes both. Refuse a new SERVICES_QUIESCED while any SERVICES_QUIESCED for the same purge_id is not closed by a SERVICES_RESTORED; and make SERVICES_RESTORED validate that its restored container set equals the open quiesce record's exact set (refuse otherwise). Apply the same "one open record at a time, exact match on close" rule to WRITER_FENCE_ENABLED/RESTORED and AUTOVACUUM_DISABLED/RESTORED (per relation) if they have the same weakness -- check and say. Tests for the quiesce case at least.

ALLOWED FILES: sql/v3/migrations/016_v3_governed_derived_purge.sql; sql/v3/migration-manifest.txt (016 hash); deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json (regenerated identity values only, via scripts/operator/v3_schema_identity.py); tests/test_v3_governed_derived_purge.py; any test pinning the 016 hash or regenerated identity (list each); CHANGES.md (amend the purge P1 entry). Nothing else.

VALIDATION TO RUN AND REPORT WITH EXACT COUNTS: ruff check scripts tests; python -m pytest tests/test_v3_lineage_migrations.py tests/test_v3_production_migration_operation.py tests/test_v3_production_application_deployment.py tests/test_v3_release_gate_f2d.py tests/test_v3_governed_derived_purge.py -q -p no:warnings (PG18 tests skip on the runner: list them as written-not-run); validate_authority on deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json (expect []).
